name: Munnar NH-85 Gap Road Landslide Area
description: Heavy rockfalls and landslide activities during monsoon along NH-85 hill cuttings.
safety_instructions: Do not travel in heavy rains or post-sunset. Avoid parking near cliff shoulders.
recommended_action: Wait at nearest forest checkpost or take alternative Adimaly bypass.

name: Ooty-Kallar Ghat Animal Crossing Sector
description: Regular elephant and gaur crossing routes intersecting the hairpin ghat roads.
safety_instructions: Do not stop vehicles to photograph wildlife. Do not sound vehicle horn.
recommended_action: Maintain slow steady speed. Proceed carefully under guard instructions.

name: Calangute Beach Rip Current Corridor
description: Unpredictable ocean rip currents and shelf drop-offs with high drowning records.
safety_instructions: Swim strictly inside green flags. Avoid sea entry after sunset or under red flag.
recommended_action: Follow verbal instructions of Drishti Lifeguards patrolling the beach.

name: Paharganj Bazar Pickpocketing Belt
description: Densely populated alley markets with high report rates of bag-slitting and pickpocketing.
safety_instructions: Carry backpacks on front. Keep cash and phones in inner zipped pockets.
recommended_action: Proceed to Main Bazar Road and remain in well-lit public corridors.

name: Ukkadam Junction Flyover Construction Zone
description: Construction debris, heavy forklift movements, and temporary lane merges.
safety_instructions: Maintain speed below 30 km/h. Watch for sudden orange barricade lane shifts.
recommended_action: Keep distance from heavy earth movers and follow traffic police signs.

name: Taj East Gate Tout & Scam Zone
description: Aggressive unauthorized tour guides and handicraft emporium commission agents.
safety_instructions: Do not accept free rides or guides. Purchase Taj tickets only from official ASI counters/apps.
recommended_action: Politely refuse tout solicitations. Proceed straight to Taj entry gate.

name: Solang Valley Rohtang Black Ice Hazard
description: Accumulation of slippery black ice on narrow hairpin roads during winter mornings.
safety_instructions: Avoid early morning driving. Ensure vehicle is fitted with snow chains if required.
recommended_action: Drive in low gears. Adhere to Border Roads Organisation (BRO) advisories.

name: Shimla Ridge Monkey Attack Sector
description: Dense population of aggressive rhesus macaques snatching food and bags from tourists.
safety_instructions: Keep all food items inside bags. Do not make direct eye contact or threaten monkeys.
recommended_action: Walk calmly without displaying plastic bags or food packets.

name: Kodaikanal Pillar Rocks Cliff Slip Zone
description: Extremely slippery trails, steep vertical drop-offs, and sudden dense fog covers.
safety_instructions: Do not cross protective chain fencing. Stay on paved observation platforms.
recommended_action: Follow warnings on security boards and obey forest patrol rangers.

name: Darjeeling Hill Cart Road Landslide Sector
description: Monsoon mudslides blocking the narrow toy train tracks and national highway.
safety_instructions: Avoid traveling in torrential rain. Check route status before departure.
recommended_action: Follow West Bengal Highway Patrol redirection to safer foothill routes.

name: Hawa Mahal Bazaar Gem Scam Sector
description: Unauthorized gem dealers lure tourists with schemes to ship tax-free precious stones.
safety_instructions: Never buy gems or jewelry under export schemes. Shop only at RTDC approved emporiums.
recommended_action: Walk away from unsolicited sales pitches. Report fraud to local police outpost.

name: Udaipur Lake Pichola Swell Hazard
description: Unregistered small boats operating without lifejackets during evening choppy waters.
safety_instructions: Only board government-licensed boats. Ensure lifejackets are securely worn.
recommended_action: Refuse boarding overloaded boats. Report violations to Pichola Jetty Desk.

name: Mehrangarh Fort Steep Ascent Heat Area
description: Severe dehydration and heat strokes on stone pathways during summer afternoons.
safety_instructions: Carry adequate drinking water/ORS. Wear hats and apply high SPF sun protection.
recommended_action: Use shaded rest alcoves inside the fort complex to cool down.

name: Mumbai Marine Drive High Tide Wave Zone
description: Violent waves crashing over the promenade during high tide and heavy monsoon surges.
safety_instructions: Do not sit on the parapet wall during high tide warning windows.
recommended_action: Move back to the opposite pedestrian walkway under police command.

name: Kolkata Howrah Bridge Pedestrian Squeeze
description: High rush of porters and pedestrian traffic with minor pickpocketing risk.
safety_instructions: Hold bags securely. Walk strictly on designated pedestrian walkways.
recommended_action: Walk at a steady pace without stopping to take photos on the main span.

name: Sundarbans Tiger Reserve Estuarine Risk
description: Habitat of Royal Bengal tigers and saltwater crocodiles. Severe risk if landing on banks.
safety_instructions: Do not step off tour boats onto muddy river banks. Avoid swimming or dipping hands.
recommended_action: Keep inside boat enclosures and follow guide instructions implicitly.

name: Rishikesh Shivpuri Rapid Currents
description: Violent Grade III/IV river rapids along Ganga river channel causing kayak tipping.
safety_instructions: Raft only with certified outfitters. Wear double-buckled life vests and helmets.
recommended_action: If thrown into water, maintain defensive swimming posture (feet forward, head up).

name: Hampi Anjanadri Hill Wild Monkey Trail
description: Large aggressive langur groups demanding food along the 575 steep temple stairs.
safety_instructions: Avoid carrying loose plastic bags, flowers, or coconuts. Keep water bottles hidden.
recommended_action: Proceed in groups. Avoid throwing stones or shouting at the langurs.
source: Archaeological Survey of India Hampi Circle

name: Silk Board Junction Congestion Hazard
description: High vehicle volume with complex merging patterns and high dust pollution.
safety_instructions: Drive defensively. Avoid sudden lane switches without signaling.
recommended_action: Prefer using metro rail or outer ring road flyovers during rush hours.

name: Marina Beach Undercurrent Danger
description: Strong hidden shore currents and waves pulling swimmers into deep channels.
safety_instructions: Strict prohibition on swimming along the entire stretch of Marina Beach.
recommended_action: Stay on the sandy dry beach. Obey beach police warning sirens.

name: Mahabalipuram Shore Rocks Tidal Sweep
description: Slippery algae on shore boulders with sudden high waves sweep risks.
safety_instructions: Do not climb wet black sea boulders. Keep kids away from breaking wave zones.
recommended_action: Walk strictly along paved paths of the monument park.

name: Madurai Temple Chithirai Crowd Squeeze
description: Extreme pedestrian density during annual festival processions with pickpocketing.
safety_instructions: Leave valuables in hotel locker. Avoid pushing into deep crowd clusters.
recommended_action: Use outer circle concentric streets to bypass major congested routes.

name: Pamban Bridge Gale Wind Road Hazard
description: Violent oceanic crosswinds exceeding 55 km/h acting on two-wheelers and high buses.
safety_instructions: Stop two-wheelers when wind warning lights are active on Pamban Road Bridge.
recommended_action: Reduce speed, turn on hazard lights, and follow highway patrol escort.

name: Fort Kochi Beach Rip Channel
description: Deep drop-offs caused by active shipping channel dredging adjacent to beach.
safety_instructions: No bathing or wading in water near Chinese Fishing Net platforms.
recommended_action: Remain on the paved sea walkway. Obey beach guard warnings.
source: Kochi City Police Coast Guard Division

name: Wayanad Lakkidi Ghat Elephant Zone
description: Frequent night movement of wild tusker herds on the Thamarassery Ghat Pass.
safety_instructions: Do not drive two-wheelers past 9 PM. Strictly no parking along ghat bends.
recommended_action: Drive steadily in low gear. Call emergency helpline if animal blocks road.

name: Kathmandu Thamel Tourist Pickpocket Zone
description: Crowded lanes with street touts and organized petty theft targeting tourists.
safety_instructions: Keep passports in hotel lockers. Secure valuables in sling bags across chest.
recommended_action: Walk along main street lights. Refuse hotel tout solicitations.

name: Everest Base Camp Trail Altitude Hazard
description: Severe risk of Acute Mountain Sickness (AMS) above 3,500m elevation.
safety_instructions: Do not ascend more than 500m per day. Rest and hydrate adequately.
recommended_action: Descend immediately to Namche Bazaar if headaches, nausea or confusion occur.

name: Annapurna Deurali Avalanche Corridor
description: High risk of snow slide and active rock avalanche between Himalaya and Deurali.
safety_instructions: Start trekking early morning. Check avalanche warnings at Machapuchare Base Camp.
recommended_action: Move quickly through the designated 1.5km danger corridor without stopping.

name: Pokhara Phewa Lake Sudden Gale Area
description: Sudden afternoon windstorms creating high waves capsizing tourist rowboats.
safety_instructions: Ensure lifejackets are fully buckled. Do not boat past 5:00 PM.
recommended_action: Paddle immediately to closest shore if wind gusts increase.

name: Sigiriya Rock Fortress Wasp Nest Area
description: Giant honeybee nests on rock walls. Loud noises or bright clothes trigger swarms.
safety_instructions: Maintain silence along the steel stairs. Wear muted color clothing. Do not swat.
recommended_action: Retreat quietly to wasp safety shelter rooms located along the path.

name: Ella Rock Cliff Edge Trail
description: Unmarked cliff edges, high winds, and severe drop risks near the Ella Gap drop-off.
safety_instructions: Do not stand on rock edges for photos. Hire local guides for twilight treks.
recommended_action: Remain strictly on the foot trail demarcated by stones.

name: Galle Fort Tuk-Tuk Overcharging ring
description: Tuk-Tuk drivers charging exorbitant rates and pushing unlicensed spice gardens.
safety_instructions: Agree on price before boarding. Decline visits to unrequested factories.
recommended_action: Use taxi apps like PickMe/Uber or hire official tourism-registered cabs.

name: Mirissa Beach Rip Current Zone
description: Strong underwater undertows near the Mirissa Coconut Tree Hill beach cove.
safety_instructions: Do not wade into deep water. Watch for beach warning flag displays.
recommended_action: Swim in shallow protected zones. Call beach patrol in emergency.

name: Bangkok Patpong Night Market Pickpockets
description: Dense night market crowd with active bag-snatchers and overcharging strip club touts.
safety_instructions: Do not follow touts offering free adult shows. Hold bags securely.
recommended_action: Keep walking towards the main Silom road or BTS station.

name: Phuket Karon Beach Monsoon Waves
description: High seasonal waves and powerful undertows pulling swimmers into open ocean.
safety_instructions: Red Flag indicates absolute swimming ban. Do not challenge waves.
recommended_action: Respect lifeguard signs. Swim only when red-yellow flags are present.

name: Chiang Mai Doi Suthep Mountain Highway
description: Sharp mountain curves with high collision rate of inexperienced scooter tourists.
safety_instructions: Do not ride without valid motorcycle license and helmet. Keep left.
recommended_action: Use red Songthaew trucks for mountain transit. Keep speed under 35km/h.

name: Pattaya Beach Jet Ski Scam Area
description: Operators charge tourists large sums claiming body damage on returned jet skis.
safety_instructions: Take detailed photos of jet ski body prior to launch. Never leave passport as deposit.
recommended_action: Rent only from operators displaying official municipal license tags.

name: Kuala Lumpur Bukit Bintang Phone Snatching
description: Motorcycle riders snatching smartphones from tourists standing near road shoulders.
safety_instructions: Do not use phone close to main curbs. Face away from traffic flow.
recommended_action: Step back into shopping center walkways or sheltered bus stops.

name: Cameron Highlands Tapah Road Slips
description: Slope failures and mud flows blocking Route 59 during rainy season.
safety_instructions: Avoid night driving on mountain routes. Monitor slope warning signs.
recommended_action: Follow Public Works Department (JKR) detour routes.

name: Langkawi Pantai Cenang Marine Stinger Zone
description: Box jellyfish (stinger) seasonal sightings close to Langkawi beaches.
safety_instructions: Wear full body stinger suits. Do not touch transparent floating blobs.
recommended_action: Douse affected skin with vinegar instantly. Call 999 for ambulance.

name: Penang Batu Ferringhi Scooter Danger
description: Inexperienced water sport riders and high speed local buses merging on coastal road.
safety_instructions: Keep speed moderate. Watch for pedestrians walking alongside road edge.
recommended_action: Utilize pedestrian walkways. Ride only with helmet.

name: Marina Bay Sands Drone No-Fly Sector
description: Restricted civil aviation airspace. Drone operations without CAAS permit are illegal.
safety_instructions: Do not unpack or launch unmanned aerial vehicles in the downtown district.
recommended_action: Comply with CAAS laws to avoid heavy fines or arrest.

name: Orchard Road Shopping Squeeze Corridor
description: Dense pedestrian crossings near MRT entrances during peak holiday periods.
safety_instructions: Keep bags closed. Do not stand still on busy stairwell exit points.
recommended_action: Follow underground pedestrian underpasses for less dense walking routes.

name: Geylang Unlicensed Clinic Alert
description: Reports of unlicensed clinics selling illegal pills and counterfeit medications.
safety_instructions: Purchase medication only from licensed retail pharmacies or clinics.
recommended_action: Report suspicious medical vendors to Health Sciences Authority.

name: Shinjuku Kabukicho Drink Spiking Zone
description: Aggressive host club touts, drink-spiking reports, and card overcharging.
safety_instructions: Do not enter bars recommended by street touts. Never leave drinks unattended.
recommended_action: Stay on main avenue of Kabukicho. Seek help from police box (Koban) near theater.

name: Mount Fuji Yoshida Trail Scree Area
description: Loose volcanic gravel causing slip falls and hypothermia due to rapid weather drops.
safety_instructions: Climb only during official summer season. Use proper hiking boots and warm wear.
recommended_action: Follow signs to emergency mountain huts. Stay on marked descending paths.

name: Kyoto Gion Private Alley Restriction
description: Heavy fines for taking photos in private Geisha alleys without authorization.
safety_instructions: Obey local Gion sign boards. Do not touch or block working Geiko/Maiko.
recommended_action: Remain on main public Hanami-koji Street corridors.

name: Seoul Myeongdong Alley Crowding Zone
description: Heavy pedestrian congestion in narrow street food alleys with minor theft risk.
safety_instructions: Do not push into densely crowded narrow corridors. Locate emergency exit arrows.
recommended_action: Walk along broader outer streets or head to main subway plaza.

name: Jeju Jusangjeolli Cliff Coast Spray
description: Slippery basalt columns, high coastal winds, and dangerous tidal surges.
safety_instructions: Do not climb rock barriers. Keep within designated wooden observation deck limits.
recommended_action: Follow park supervisor guides and read safety boards.

name: Busan Haeundae Beach Undercurrents
description: Seasonal rip currents and tidal swells capable of sweeping swimmers away from shore.
safety_instructions: Do not swim when beach flag is Red. Wear lifevests at all times.
recommended_action: Heed directions of the marine rescue boats patrolling Haeundae.

name: Dubai Al Qudra Remote Desert Heat
description: Extremely high summer temperatures (exceeding 48C) and limited cellular reception.
safety_instructions: Do not venture off-road without a 4x4 convoy and satellite radio. Carry extra water.
recommended_action: Stick to designated Al Qudra cycling tracks and visitor centers.

name: Abu Dhabi E-11 Highway Wind Fog
description: Dense morning fog and sand sweeps causing severe reduction in driving visibility.
safety_instructions: Reduce speed. Turn on fog lights. Do not use hazard lights while driving.
recommended_action: Pull over to the nearest petrol station if visibility drops below 20m.

name: Riyadh Edge of the World Cliff Trail
description: Loose rock cliffs, steep vertical drop-offs, and lack of cellular connectivity.
safety_instructions: Do not approach trail cliffs without safety gear. Exit reserve before sunset.
recommended_action: Hire licensed guides. Remain on the marked vehicle dirt trail.
source: Saudi Commission for Tourism & National Heritage

name: Mecca Mina Pedestrian Flow Sector
description: High-density pilgrim movement during annual Hajj season requiring strict routing.
safety_instructions: Follow the designated unidirectional pedestrian path. Stay hydrated.
recommended_action: Walk with your group and do not attempt to walk back against crowd flow.
source: Ministry of Hajj and Umrah Safety Division

name: Istanbul Grand Bazaar Pickpocket Belt
description: High crowd density in historic alleys with card scanners and pickpockets.
safety_instructions: Keep wallet in front pocket. Keep bag zippers locked. Avoid paying in foreign cash.
recommended_action: Remain in the main vaulted halls of the Grand Bazaar.

name: Cappadocia Goreme Valley Wind Shift
description: Sudden high altitude crosswinds making hot air balloon landings unstable.
safety_instructions: Fly only with operators verified by the Turkish Civil Aviation Authority.
recommended_action: Follow pilot safety landing brace positions in balloon baskets.
source: Turkish Directorate General of Civil Aviation

name: Pamukkale Travertine Slippery Terrace
description: Wet algae and mineral deposits on steep limestone terraces causing fall slips.
safety_instructions: Walk strictly barefoot on the terraced path. Avoid running or carrying items.
recommended_action: Walk along the designated dry wooden boardwalk.

name: London Soho Street Phone Snatchers
description: E-bike and scooter riders snatching phones from tourists near restaurants.
safety_instructions: Do not text while walking close to road curbs. Keep phone concealed.
recommended_action: Move inside restaurants or walk on shop-front pathways.

name: Scottish Highlands Glencoe Winter Trail
description: Sudden blizzard whiteouts, freezing conditions, and missing navigation markers.
safety_instructions: Never hike without mountain GPS, survival blankets, and emergency beacons.
recommended_action: Return immediately to Glencoe Mountain Visitor Centre if wind drops temp.

name: Stonehenge Restricted Drone Zone
description: Drone flight restriction zone to protect historical monument structures.
safety_instructions: Do not fly drones within 1km of the stones without CAA and English Heritage permit.
recommended_action: Walk along the visitor circular path.

name: Paris Champ de Mars Pickpocket Ring
description: Aggressive street petition scams and organized groups targeting tourist bags.
safety_instructions: Do not sign paper petitions. Refuse street vendor solicitations.
recommended_action: Proceed to Eiffel Tower security check lines or open park lanes.

name: Nice Promenade Anglais bike Lane Squeeze
description: High speed electric bike traffic intersecting tourist pedestrian walkways.
safety_instructions: Stay outside the marked cycle lane paths. Watch before crossing.
recommended_action: Walk on the paved sidewalk adjacent to the beach wall.

name: Chamonix Mont-Blanc Off-Piste Avalanche
description: Active glacier crevasses and avalanche slips on Vallée Blanche off-piste trails.
safety_instructions: Rope up at all times. Ski only with licensed Mountain Guides.
recommended_action: Check Aiguille du Midi safety board before skiing down.
source: Office de Haute Montagne de Chamonix (OHM)

name: Rome Colosseum Bag Slitting Area
description: Pickpockets slitting backpacks near crowded ticket lines and metro exits.
safety_instructions: Wear backpacks on front. Do not hold cash in hand while purchasing tickets.
recommended_action: Stay close to Carabinieri police stations near the monument.

name: Venice Piazza San Marco High Tide (Acqua Alta)
description: Tidal flooding submerging San Marco square under 100cm+ of salt water.
safety_instructions: Use the raised wooden walkways. Do not walk barefoot in flooded water.
recommended_action: Adhere to Venice City warning sirens and local police barriers.

name: Amalfi Coast Highway Narrow Curve Slip
description: Extremely narrow curves with active local bus merges and high crash records.
safety_instructions: Avoid driving rental cars. Use local SITA buses with professional drivers.
recommended_action: Keep speed under 25km/h if driving. Yield to large oncoming coaches.

name: Barcelona Las Ramblas Pickpocket Belt
description: Street scam gambling rings (Three Cups) and organized distraction pickpocketing.
safety_instructions: Never participate in street games. Keep hands on wallet/bag inside crowds.
recommended_action: Walk along main street axis towards Placa Catalunya.

name: Madrid Puerta del Sol Rose Seller Scams
description: Women handing roses claiming they are gifts and then demanding cash forcefully.
safety_instructions: Do not accept roses, bracelets or sprigs from street actors.
recommended_action: Keep hands down and walk past without interacting.

name: Mallorca Playa de Palma Rip Current
description: Strong tidal sweeps off beach barrier bays pulling tourists out to deep water.
safety_instructions: Swim strictly inside green flagged zones. Observe lifeguard towers.
recommended_action: If caught, swim parallel to shore to escape current. Stay calm.

name: Berlin Alexanderplatz Theft watch Area
description: Groups engaging tourists in fake surveys or shell games to pickpocket pockets.
safety_instructions: Refuse signing local petitions. Keep your backpack zipped shut.
recommended_action: Walk towards the Alexanderplatz train terminal portals.

name: Zugspitze Summit Glacier Ridge
description: Extremely steep ridge drops and sudden black ice covering metal walkways.
safety_instructions: Hold walkway handrails. Do not step beyond safety barrier fencing.
recommended_action: Return inside the summit terminal building if crosswinds increase.

name: Zermatt Glacier Crevasse Sector
description: Unstable snow bridges covering deep active crevasses outside ski zones.
safety_instructions: Stick to marked yellow/red poles. Do not follow off-piste ski tracks.
recommended_action: Report accidents to Swiss Alpine Rescue or call Rega helpline 1414.

name: Interlaken Paragliding Landing Wind Shear
description: Sudden strong valley wind shifts making landings on Hoehematte park unstable.
safety_instructions: Check safety wind socks before launch. Fly only with SHV certified pilots.
recommended_action: Use the alternative landing zones if green warning light flashes.
source: Swiss Hang Gliding and Paragliding Association (SHV)

name: Grand Canyon South Rim Network Deadzone
description: No mobile network or cellular telemetry inside the inner canyon corridor.
safety_instructions: Download offline area maps before hiking. Carry satellite messenger beacons.
recommended_action: Consult NPS Ranger stations for public emergency radios.

name: Times Square Mascot & CD Scams
description: Costumed characters demanding large tips for photos and forcing music CDs.
safety_instructions: Do not accept music CDs. Avoid taking photos with unsolicited characters.
recommended_action: Walk towards Broadway pedestrian corridors or call NYPD officers.

name: Yellowstone Geyser Basin Thermal Crust
description: Fragile thin thermal crust covering boiling acidic water pools.
safety_instructions: Stay strictly on wooden boardwalk paths. Never step off onto ground.
recommended_action: Follow park ranger safety instructions. Do not throw items in pools.

name: Yosemite Half Dome Cable Slip Area
description: Extremely slippery granite rock and high fall risks from Half Dome cable route.
safety_instructions: Do not climb during rain or lightning warning windows. Wear high grip gloves.
recommended_action: Remain clipped to steel support cables with safety harnesses.

name: Miami Beach South Beach Rip currents
description: Sudden sandbar drops and high-velocity offshore rip currents.
safety_instructions: Swim only in front of open lifeguard towers. Check flag color daily.
recommended_action: If swept, float on back, swim parallel to the shore to escape current.

name: San Francisco Tenderloin Area Warning
description: High rates of vehicle break-ins, street drug activities, and robbery.
safety_instructions: Do not leave luggage visible inside parked cars. Avoid walking alone after dark.
recommended_action: Proceed to Union Square or Market Street shopping corridors.

name: Hawaii Volcanoes Kilauea Gas Hazard
description: High concentration of toxic sulfur dioxide gas and active volcanic vent hazards.
safety_instructions: Stay upwind of volcanic gas plumes. Avoid walking on fresh black lava crust.
recommended_action: Consult Hawaii Volcanoes Observatory safety guides immediately.

name: Banff Bow Valley Grizzly Crossing
description: Active grizzly bear feeding corridor adjacent to highway and hiking trails.
safety_instructions: Carry bear spray in accessible location. Make noise while walking.
recommended_action: Do not approach wildlife. Turn back if fresh bear tracks are seen.

name: Whistler Blackcomb Avalanche Runout
description: Steep snow chutes prone to sliding under high wind load conditions.
safety_instructions: Do not ski past designated boundary signs. Carry avalanche transceivers.
recommended_action: Follow signs to main ski village trails.

name: Toronto Yonge Street taxi Scams
description: Unregistered cabs using fake card readers to copy tourist credit cards.
safety_instructions: Only flag cabs with official city taxi license plates. Demand meter use.
recommended_action: Prefer using public transit (TTC) or official rideshare applications.

name: Cancun Beach Hotel Zone undertow
description: Extremely strong undertows and tidal waves along the eastern ocean front.
safety_instructions: Swim strictly when Green flag is raised. Avoid sea entry when Red flag is up.
recommended_action: Swim in the shallow hotel zone pools or seek lifeguard directions.

name: Mexico City Centro Historico Pickpockets
description: Distraction pickpocket rings near Zocalo plaza and crowded metro entries.
safety_instructions: Keep valuables inside front zipped pockets. Avoid wearing expensive jewelry.
recommended_action: Remain in highly populated pedestrian zones near police patrols.

name: Cabo San Lucas Lovers Beach Wave Surge
description: Violent shore break waves crashing onto rocks near Pacific ocean interface.
safety_instructions: Strict ban on swimming on the Pacific ocean side (Divorce Beach).
recommended_action: Remain on the protected sandy bay side of Lovers Beach.
source: Capitania de Puerto de Cabo San Lucas

name: Rio Copacabana Beach theft Zone
description: Fast-moving youth gang thefts (arrastoes) snatching items from beach towels.
safety_instructions: Do not carry phones or cameras onto beach sand. Keep cash hidden inside pockets.
recommended_action: Remain close to beach lifeguard stations (Postos) with police presence.
source: Policia Militar do Estado do Rio de Janeiro

name: Amazon Rainforest Manaus River Gap
description: Uncharted jungle waterways, lack of cell tower signal, and dangerous wildlife.
safety_instructions: Navigate strictly with registered guides. Carry satellite communications.
recommended_action: Do not drink unpurified river water. Stick to marked eco-lodge channels.

name: Buenos Aires San Telmo Distraction Scams
description: Scams involving dropping liquid on clothing and stealing bags during cleanup.
safety_instructions: If sprayed with liquid, do not put bag down. Walk away to secure shop.
recommended_action: Ignore helpers offering to clean clothes. Report theft to nearest police patrol.
source: Policia de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires

name: El Chalten Fitz Roy Gale Winds
description: Violent winds exceeding 90 km/h and rapid weather drops on exposed trails.
safety_instructions: Wear windproof layers. Check mountain forecast before ascending Laguna de los Tres.
recommended_action: Seek shelter in forested trail sections if winds increase.
source: Parque Nacional Los Glaciares Safety Outpost

name: Bondi Beach Backpackers Rip Current
description: Deep rip channels (Backpackers Express) near southern rocks pulling swimmers out.
safety_instructions: Swim strictly between red and yellow flags. Never swim in rock channels.
recommended_action: Obey Bondi Beach lifeguards and watch warning sign board displays.

name: Outback Alice Springs Dehydration Risk
description: Severe heat exposure, lack of water sources, and absolute cellular signal dead-zone.
safety_instructions: Carry minimum 10 liters of water per person. Inform contacts of travel route.
recommended_action: Do not leave vehicle if it breaks down. Wait for police highway patrol.

name: Cairns Great Barrier Reef Jellyfish Area
description: Seasonal presence of highly toxic Irukandji and box jellyfish in coastal reef waters.
safety_instructions: Wear full body Lycra stinger suits. Do not swim outside stinger nets.
recommended_action: If stung, apply vinegar continuously and seek immediate medical help.

name: Queenstown Shotover River Rapid Fluctuation
description: Sudden water level increases and rapid currents downstream of hydro stations.
safety_instructions: Wear high quality lifejackets and helmets. Avoid wading near canyon bends.
recommended_action: Follow warnings on river safety signs and register with adventure desk.

name: Milford Road Rockfall Corridor
description: Active rock avalanche zone along State Highway 94 near Homer Tunnel.
safety_instructions: Do not stop vehicle within marked rockfall warning road stretches.
recommended_action: Drive directly through. Adhere to transit signals at Homer Tunnel.

name: Tongariro Alpine Crossing Volcanic Vent
description: Active volcanic steam vents and acid lake gas emissions near Te Maari craters.
safety_instructions: Do not step off marked trail. Do not stay near vent steam columns.
recommended_action: Check DOC volcanic status indicators before beginning the crossing.

name: Cape Town Table Mountain Path Security Area
description: Isolated hiking paths prone to opportunistic muggings targeting tourists.
safety_instructions: Do not hike alone. Travel in groups of 4+. Keep cameras and phones hidden.
recommended_action: Stick to the Cableway route or hike only when volunteer safety rangers are present.

name: Kruger National Park Elephant Crossing
description: Unfenced roads with elephant and buffalo herds crossing. Risk of vehicle charging.
safety_instructions: Maintain minimum 50m distance from elephants. Keep vehicle engine running.
recommended_action: Do not step out of the car. Back up slowly if herd moves towards you.

name: Johannesburg CBD High Robbery Sector
description: Street robbery and muggings targeting foreigners walking in downtown districts.
safety_instructions: Do not walk on foot. Keep car doors locked and windows rolled up at intersections.
recommended_action: Use registered door-to-door shuttle services or hotel private drivers.

name: Giza Pyramids Camel Ride Tout Scam
description: Aggressive camel/horse ride providers trapping tourists and demanding extra cash to let them descend.
safety_instructions: Agree on complete trip details and get tickets from official Giza entrance. Ignore street handlers.
recommended_action: Proceed to tourist police booths located inside the Pyramid complex area.

name: Sinai Desert Highway Security Zone
description: Remote desert highways with security checkpoints and restricted entry corridors.
safety_instructions: Do not venture off-road. Keep passport and travel authorization documents ready.
recommended_action: Travel strictly in tourist bus convoys registered with the local Ministry.

name: Marrakech Medina Alley Pickpockets
description: Confusing labyrinth alleys with aggressive young guides demanding money to exit.
safety_instructions: Never follow street boys offering directions. Use offline GPS navigation apps.
recommended_action: Step inside registered shops or head towards main Jemaa el-Fnaa square.

name: Atlas Mountains Toubkal scree Slide
description: Unstable rock debris and sudden snow slides on the ascent towards Mount Toubkal.
safety_instructions: Hire certified local guides at Imlil. Wear high ankle support hiking boots.
recommended_action: Utilize Refuge du Toubkal for emergency communication and shelter.
